items.headline: $GIWA Fake L2 Bridge Drained of 766 ETH in Scam
items.summary: A fake $GIWA Layer 2 bridge was drained of 766 ETH after DYORSWAP mistook it for the Upbit-backed project. The platform promises 40% reimbursement for wallets that bridged under 5 ETH.

items.headline: $LINK Launches CCIP 2.0 With Faster Transfers
items.summary: $LINK's Chainlink rolled out CCIP 2.0 with custom verifiers and faster cross-chain transfers. Existing integrations keep working, while new token-pool controls require an opt-in upgrade.

items.headline: $POL Staking Rate Boosted to 7.7% for Two Months
items.summary: Polygon plans a two-month boost lifting gross $POL staking rewards to 7.7%, up from a ~3% baseline. The fee-funded increase rewards stake held during the window.

items.headline: $NEAR ETF by Bitwise Clears Listing Hurdles
items.summary: Bitwise's $NEAR ETF cleared listing and registration hurdles, with plans to stake its holdings. The fund carries a 0.75% management fee plus a charge on staking rewards.

items.headline: $ONDO Perps Adds Spot Trading for 12 Tokenized Stocks
items.summary: $ONDO Perps added spot trading for 12 tokenized stocks and ETFs, letting traders use purchased tokens as collateral for short perp positions. Spot fees are waived for the first 30 days.
